coverage: Literal custom CSS rules, with media contexts separate from base. No rendered measurements.

rules.selector: /* any other focusable (e.g. a keyboard-focusable scroll row) gets the kit ring, never the browser default */ :where(.pm) :focus-visible

/* controls inside clipped / sideways-scrolling rows draw their ring INSIDE the control so overflow never cuts it */ :where(.pmfq-filt,.pmal-pills,.pmcl-pills,.pmil-pills,.pmsu-rail,.pmag-scroll,.pmrs-feed,.pmfq-row,.pmco-topics,.pmbl-pills,.pmcg-pills) :where(a[href],button,input,[tabindex]):focus-visible

declarations.box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rim),0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--pm-cloud) 10%,transparent) inset,0 14px 30px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.55)

rules.selector:
/* TEXT-SAFE accents: coral is a SURFACE colour on paper (chips, fills, rings) — accent text on paper is the deep mix; on night grounds the coral itself reads */
.pm

/* the root carries NO transform: a translate there would become the containing block of the fixed sheet */
.pm.pmhd

/* ISLANDS — solid paper (or night) cards, never glass; at the very top of the home page only the link pill keeps its paper */
.pmhd-isl

rules.selector:
/* the lift: the whole sheet rises, its torn bottom edge crossing the hero; content drifts up a little faster */
.pmld.is-exit

/* the sheet: a notebook page a little larger than the screen, so its tilted corners never show while it covers */
.pmtr-sheet

/* leaving: the sheet slides in from the right, tilted and lifted, settles flat; the name rides a beat behind and its underline draws */
.pmtr-leave .pmtr-sheet

/* arriving: covered in the server HTML; the page is turned on to the left and the sheet slides off */
html.pmtr-arrive .pmtr-ssr .pmtr-ul path,.pmtr-enter .pmtr-ul path

/* the lifting edge throws a shadow on the section beneath, and that section comes out of the dark as it is uncovered */
.pm-rev.is-act>.pm-rev-in::before

/* diagonal cuts: the section hangs over its neighbour and is cut on a slope (clip-path, so the neighbour shows through) */
.pm-cut-t

declarations.transform: translate3d(calc(var(--px) + (var(--fx) - var(--px)) * var(--f)),calc(var(--py) + (var(--fy) - var(--py)) * var(--f)),0) rotate(var(--rot))

declarations.transition: stroke-dashoffset .6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1) calc(1.1s + var(--i)*.12s),fill-opacity .4s calc(1.5s + var(--i)*.12s)

rules.selector:
/* hover / focus: the note straightens and lifts, its photos colour in, the rest of the wall steps back */
.pmrv-wall:has(.pmrv-card:hover) .pmrv-card:not(:hover) .pmrv-in,.pmrv-wall:has(.pmrv-card:focus-within) .pmrv-card:not(:focus-within) .pmrv-in

/* phones have no hover: the project photo colours in once the note is up */
.pmrv.is-ph.is-on .pmrv-wk .pmrv-skc
/* local fix for the shared Btn (kit bug): the hover fill was positioned on the label and painted over its text; fill the whole face, under the label */ .pmpr .pm-lbl
